author: mfhansen
title: PyTorch Models tests fail with pyarrow/NumPy ABI mismatch (ImportError: pyarrow requires NumPy 2.0)
signature: pyarrow requires numpy 2.0 or newer but older numpy installed causing importerror in datasets/pyarrow dependency chain|Dependencies

failed_jobs.name: PyTorch Models tests / PyTorch Models tests
failed_jobs.symptom: 7 HuggingFace transformer model-hub tests fail at import time with ImportError: pyarrow requires NumPy 2.0 or newer, found 1.26.4

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status
failed_jobs.symptom: Aggregate status check fails because the PyTorch Models tests job failed

key_errors:
File "/__w/openvino/openvino/install/tests/model_hub_tests/pytorch/test_hf_transformers.py", line 59, in load_model
    from datasets import Audio, load_dataset

File "/venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/pyarrow/__init__.py", line 59, in <module>
    from pyarrow.lib import (BuildInfo, CppBuildInfo, RuntimeInfo, set_timezone_db_path,
ImportError: pyarrow requires NumPy 2.0 or newer, found 1.26.4
root_cause: The PyTorch model-hub test job pins numpy==1.26.4 via install/tests/requirements_pytorch (line 7), reinstalling over the newer numpy that was installed with openvino's wheel. The hf_transformers test env (install/tests/model_hub_tests/pytorch/envs/hf_transformers.txt) separately pulls in datasets==3.0.1, which installs pyarrow>=15.0.0; the resolved pyarrow-26.0.1 wheel requires NumPy >= 2.0 at import time (its compiled extension enforces the ABI at runtime), so importing `datasets` (which imports pyarrow) raises ImportError as soon as any hf_transformers test tries to load a HF dataset. This is unrelated to the PR's actual change (a CSV docs file) - it is a latent, environment-wide dependency conflict between the pinned numpy==1.26.4 requirement and the newer pyarrow resolved by datasets==3.0.1.
reproduction_steps:
1. Build/install OpenVINO as in CI.
2. pip install -r install/tests/requirements_pytorch (pins numpy==1.26.4).
3. pip install -r install/tests/model_hub_tests/pytorch/envs/hf_transformers.txt (installs datasets==3.0.1 -> pyarrow-26.0.1).
4. python3 -c "from datasets import load_dataset" -> ImportError: pyarrow requires NumPy 2.0 or newer, found 1.26.4.
recommended_actions: Pin pyarrow to a version compatible with numpy 1.26.x (e.g., pyarrow<15 or pin pyarrow explicitly in hf_transformers.txt / requirements_pytorch) or bump numpy to >=2.0 in requirements_pytorch if other pinned deps allow it.
Add an explicit pyarrow version constraint in install/tests/model_hub_tests/pytorch/envs/hf_transformers.txt to avoid resolving an incompatible pyarrow build against the pinned numpy.
Consider isolating model-hub test environments per-suite (already partially done via envs/*.txt) so a dependency resolved for one suite does not conflict with the shared numpy pin.
This is the 8th occurrence of this exact signature since 2026-11-05 - escalate to component owners to fix the pin rather than re-investigating on every merge-queue run.
prevention_strategies: Pin transitive dependencies (pyarrow) explicitly wherever a package (datasets) can silently resolve an incompatible version against another already-pinned package (numpy). Add a CI smoke import check (`python -c "import datasets"`) right after installing model-hub test requirements, before running the full test suite, to fail fast with a clearer error message. Periodically audit install/tests/requirements_pytorch and the model_hub_tests envs/*.txt files for numpy/pyarrow/datasets compatibility windows.
